lines.en: label mayadorm5:
I knock on the door and wait for Maya to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲门，等 Maya 回应。

lines.en: Chances are she won’t respond if she knows it’s me, so I decide to keep quiet instead.
lines.zh: 她要是知道是我，多半不会应，所以我决定不出声。

lines.en: A few seconds go by and no one comes to the door, but I can clearly hear movement on the other side...so, chances are that I'm just being ignored.
lines.zh: 几秒钟过去，没人来开门，但我能清楚听见里面有动静……所以多半是她故意不理我。

lines.en: That's fine, though. Because I have learned by now that repeatedly annoying Maya almost always gets her to respond to me.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。因为我现在已经学到：反复烦 Maya 几乎总能让她搭理我。

lines.en: That said, all I have to do is keep knocking.
lines.zh: 所以说，我只要一直敲下去就行。

lines.en: : Hah...
: Who is it?
I knock again, still not wanting to reveal my presence even though the chance of Maya realizing it's me is already quite high.
lines.zh: 我又敲了一下，还是不想暴露自己——尽管 Maya 猜到是我的可能性已经很高。

lines.en: : Ugh...hold on.
lines.zh: : 呃……等着。

lines.en: I manage to win in the end. Persistence really is key with girls like her.
lines.zh: 我终究还是赢了。对她这种女孩，坚持真的是关键。

lines.en: scene firstmayadorm1
: Wow. Who could have ever predicted that it was you knocking and not some other random person who didn't want to reveal their voice?
lines.zh: : 哇。谁能料到敲门的是你，而不是某个不肯暴露声音的陌生人呢。

lines.en: : You're so smart, Maya.
lines.zh: : 你真聪明，Maya。

lines.en: : Are you not hanging out with Ami tonight?
lines.zh: : 你今晚不跟 Ami 一起玩吗？

lines.en: : Ami isn’t home tonight. And I have other things I need to be taking care of anyway.
lines.zh: : Ami 今晚不在家。而且我本来就有别的事要办。

lines.en: : Does this mean we can't hang out?
lines.zh: : 那意思是我们不能一起玩吗？

lines.en: scene firstmayadorm2
: Are you out of your mind?
lines.zh: : 你疯了吗？

lines.en: : How many more times must I tell you to leave me alone before you actually...you know, start doing that?
lines.zh: : 我还得再说多少次「离我远点」，你才真的会……你知道，照做？

lines.en: : I’ve already decided that I'm going to just perpetually bother you, so you may as well just quit while you're ahead and stop asking me to leave you alone.
lines.zh: : 我已经决定要永远烦你了，所以你还是趁早认输，别再叫我离你远点了。

lines.en: : Can you at least make yourself useful and hold this? It's heavy.
lines.zh: : 你至少能起点作用吗？拿着这个。它很沉。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. Sure.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。行。

lines.en: scene firstmayadorm3
Maya hands the box over to me and it is way heavier than I expect it to be. I guess this is what I get for annoying her, though.
lines.zh: Maya 把盒子递给我，它比我预想的沉得多。不过我想这就是我烦她的下场。

lines.en: : What's in here? Can I open it?
lines.zh: : 里面是什么？我能打开吗？

lines.en: : Are you suddenly illiterate? It says ‘don’t open’ right there on the box.
lines.zh: : 你突然不识字了？盒子上明明写着「不要打开」。

lines.en: : I'm not illiterate. I just thought I might be an exception to that rule.
lines.zh: : 我不是不识字。我只是以为我可能是那条规则的例外。

lines.en: scene firstmayadorm4
: Why on earth would you of all people be an exception to that rule when I like you less than literally everyone else?...
lines.zh: : 到底为什么偏偏你会是那条规则的例外？我喜欢你比这世上的任何人都要少……

lines.en: : I don't know. Just a feeling I had.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。只是一种感觉。

lines.en: : I won’t even let you into the room and you think I’m going to let you look at my personal belongings?
lines.zh: : 我连房间都不让你进，你还以为我会让你看我的私人物品？

lines.en: : What's next? Leisurely walks through the park and long talks about our future?
lines.zh: : 下一步是什么？在公园里悠闲散步、畅谈我们的未来？

lines.en: : Sure. That sounds fun.
lines.zh: : 好啊。听起来挺不错。

lines.en: : Die.
lines.zh: : 去死。

lines.en: : Chill out. I'm not going to look inside if you really don't want me to.
lines.zh: : 冷静点。你要是真不想让我看，我不会看的。

lines.en: : It just seems really suspicious to write “don’t open” on a box. So it's not my fault for being curious.
lines.zh: : 只是在盒子上写「不要打开」看起来真的很可疑。所以我好奇不是我的错。

lines.en: scene firstmayadorm5
: You’re...curious about a lot of things, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你对……很多东西都很好奇，对吧？

lines.en: : Curiosity is human nature, after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟好奇心是人性。

lines.en: : I suppose. But what is it that makes you curious? Are you incapable of assimilating to this new world on your own? Are you looking for guidance?
lines.zh: : 我想是的。可让你好奇的到底是什么？你没法靠自己融入这个新世界？你在找向导？

lines.en: : Because, as much as you would like me to be your tour guide of all things Kumon-mi, I believe that role should belong to Ami.
lines.zh: : 因为，就算你多想让我当那个带你了解 Kumon-mi 一切的导游，我认为那个角色该归 Ami。

lines.en: : I’m perfectly capable of assimilating. I just want to put you into a position where you might accidentally reveal your secrets to me.
lines.zh: : 我完全有能力融入。我只是想把你摆到一个「可能会不小心把秘密透露给我」的位置上。

lines.en: scene firstmayadorm5r
: I see.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : And what makes you think I have any secrets worth keeping?
lines.zh: : 而你凭什么觉得我有什么值得保守的秘密？

lines.en: : We all have secrets worth keeping, don’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们都有值得保守的秘密，不是吗？

lines.en: scene firstmayadorm3
: Hm.
: What? Did that answer surprise you?
lines.zh: : 怎么？那个回答让你意外了？

lines.en: : Perhaps. You sounded almost human for a moment.
lines.zh: : 也许。有那么一瞬间，你听起来几乎像个人。

lines.en: : Thanks. I think that’s the closest to a compliment that I’ve ever received from you.
lines.zh: : 谢了。我想那是我从你这得到过的最接近夸奖的话了。

lines.en: : Don’t jump for joy just yet, as I still have no intention of telling you anything.
lines.zh: : 先别急着高兴，因为我依然不打算告诉你任何事。

lines.en: : Getting ‘my secrets’ out of me simply won’t happen. I’ve had too much practice keeping them.
lines.zh: : 想从我嘴里套出「我的秘密」是不可能的。我保守秘密练得太多了。

lines.en: : In fact, I am so confident in my ability to do so, that I am going as far as letting you handle a very important box right now.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我对这个能力自信到了这个地步：我现在就敢让你拿着一个很重要的盒子。

lines.en: : A box that, despite your desire to open it, I know will remain shut.
lines.zh: : 一个盒子，尽管你想打开它，我却知道它会一直关着。

lines.en: : You know that?
lines.zh: : 你确定？

lines.en: : Would you like to try and prove me wrong?
lines.zh: : 要不要试着证明我错了？

lines.en: Should I open the box?
lines.zh: 我要不要打开这个盒子？

lines.en: menu:
Don’t open the box
lines.zh: 不要打开

lines.en: scene firstmayadorm5r
: See? I know how these things work.
lines.zh: : 看吧？这种事我懂。

lines.en: : Now, if you’d be so inclined, please help me carry this elsewhere.
lines.zh: : 现在，如果你愿意的话，请帮我把它搬到别处去。

lines.en: : Where exactly is ‘elsewhere?’ Because I’m not exactly in the mood to carry this across town this late at night.
lines.zh: : 「别处」具体是哪儿？因为这么晚了，我可没心情扛着它横穿全城。

lines.en: : Oh? Then I suppose I will venture forth into the dark on my own.
lines.zh: : 哦？那我想我只好独自闯进黑暗了。

lines.en: : What is the worst thing that could possibly happen to a small, cute girl wandering off alone in the dark?
lines.zh: : 一个小个子可爱女孩独自在夜里乱走，最坏能发生什么事呢？

lines.en: : Are you...actually trying to convince me to come with you right now?
lines.zh: : 你这是……在真的试图说服我跟你一起去吗？

lines.en: : I don't have to. I know you are going to come with me regardless of what I say because you are attracted to me.
lines.zh: : 我不必说服。我知道不管我说什么你都会跟来，因为你被我吸引。

lines.en: : And I would be foolish to deny you the opportunity to indulge in that attraction of yours as doing so would mean that I would have to carry this box.
lines.zh: : 而我要是蠢到拒绝给你这个放纵那份吸引力的机会，那就意味着我得自己扛这个盒子。

lines.en: : And I just don't want to do that.
lines.zh: : 而我就是不想。

lines.en: : Now-
lines.zh: : 现在——

lines.en: : Please follow me.
lines.zh: : 请跟我来。

lines.en: scene black
So...
lines.zh: 所以……

lines.en: I guess I have to carry a box now?
lines.zh: 我想我现在得扛一个盒子了？

lines.en: Several minutes later...
lines.zh: 几分钟后……

lines.en: scene secretsredux1
: You’re going to have to tell me where we’re going eventually...
lines.zh: : 你迟早得告诉我我们要去哪儿……

lines.en: : Sorry, did you say something? I couldn't hear you over your unrelenting desire to sleep with me.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么了？你想睡我的执念太强，我听不清。

lines.en: : First off, stop using your divine powers to listen to my thoughts.
lines.zh: : 首先，别用你的神力偷听我的想法。

lines.en: : Second, I asked you to tell me where we're going.
lines.zh: : 其次，我问的是我们到底要去哪儿。

lines.en: : Oh. So you haven't figured it out already?
lines.zh: : 哦。你还没猜到？

lines.en: : Not really. You have to remember that I'm not that familiar with this place yet.
lines.zh: : 没有。你得记住，我对这地方还不太熟。

lines.en: : The only thing I know in this direction is the[school].
lines.zh: : 这个方向上我知道的只有[school]。

lines.en: : Then I suppose that is where we are headed.
lines.zh: : 那我想我们要去的就是那儿。

lines.en: : Would you mind explaining why we need to carry a box that says ‘don’t open’ on it to the[school] in the middle of the night?
lines.zh: : 你介意解释一下，为什么我们深更半夜要把一个写着「不要打开」的盒子搬到[school]吗？

lines.en: : Would you believe me if I told you that the box was full of explosives and that I plan on demolishing the school tonight?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你盒子里全是炸药，我今晚打算把学校炸了，你信吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: That was obviously a joke.
lines.zh: : 那显然是开玩笑。

lines.en: : I wouldn't call it obvious. In fact, I think your delivery needs a little work.
lines.zh: : 我可不觉得有多「显然」。事实上，我觉得你的表达还需要再练练。

lines.en: : You’re the one who should be focusing on delivery right now. I’m only here to act as a chaperone.
lines.zh: : 现在该操心「递送」的是你。我只是来当个监护人的。

lines.en: : Was that another joke? Because if so, you are very bad at this.
lines.zh: : 那又是一个玩笑吗？如果是，你在这方面真的很烂。

lines.en: scene secretsredux2
: Perhaps it was. Perhaps it wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 也许是。也许不是。

lines.en: : I'm afraid you'll never be close enough to me to understand my sense of humor.
lines.zh: : 恐怕你永远都不会跟我亲近到能理解我的幽默感。

lines.en: Those words carry a bit more weight to them as Maya stays several steps away from me the whole trip.
lines.zh: 这句话的分量更重了些——因为整趟路上 Maya 都跟我隔着好几步。

lines.en: I can feel her glaring back at me from time to time, but whenever I decide to walk a little faster in order to catch up, she does the same.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到她时不时回头瞪我，但只要我加快脚步想追上，她也跟着加快。

lines.en: I’m not sure why she’s so opposed to coming any closer, but I chalk it up to the fact that I don't really hide my attraction toward her and that we're all alone in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: 我不确定她为什么这么抗拒靠近我，但我把它归因于：我对自己被她吸引这件事从不掩饰，而且我俩现在大半夜独处。

lines.en: This exact scenario would excite several other girls I know, I'm sure.
lines.zh: 我确信，同样的场景会让我认识的另外几个女孩兴奋起来。

lines.en: But for Maya, it appears to do anything but.
lines.zh: 但对 Maya 来说，似乎起的是反作用。

lines.en: : You can walk a little closer to me you know.
lines.zh: : 你可以走得离我近一点，你知道的。

lines.en: : And why would I do that?
lines.zh: : 我为什么那么做？

lines.en: : It won't change when we arrive at our destination, so the distance between us doesn’t make much of a difference, does it?
lines.zh: : 反正我们到目的地时的距离也不会变，那我们现在离多远也就无所谓了，不是吗？

lines.en: : No. But it would help me feel a little less...weird.
lines.zh: : 不是。不过那样会让我感觉没那么……奇怪。

lines.en: : That's nice. But I don't really care about your feelings.
lines.zh: : 那挺好。但我不太在乎你的感受。

lines.en: : Are you saying that staying this far apart doesn't make you feel weird?
lines.zh: : 你的意思是，保持这么远你不会觉得奇怪？

lines.en: : Was what I said really that hard to understand?
lines.zh: : 我刚才说的真有那么难懂吗？

lines.en: : No. I just-
lines.zh: : 不，我只是——

lines.en: : Good. Then there's no need for us to change positions whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 好。那我们完全没有必要改变位置。

lines.en: : I’m very glad we were able to resolve this peacefully.
lines.zh: : 我真高兴我们能和平解决这件事。

lines.en: scene black
Nothing changes.
lines.zh: 什么都没变。

lines.en: The two of us just keep walking.
lines.zh: 我俩只是继续走。

lines.en: scene secretsredux3
: Are we almost there? Because my arms are really starting to get tired.
lines.zh: : 我们快到了吗？我的胳膊真的开始酸了。

lines.en: : Are they? I remember you being a bit stronger.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我记得你以前要强壮一点。

lines.en: : What a shame that one of your very few uses isn't even all that useful to begin with.
lines.zh: : 真可惜，你那为数不多的一点用处，本来也不怎么有用。

lines.en: : Well, excuse me for not being used to a new body yet.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉我还没习惯这具新身体。

lines.en: : No matter. We've just arrived anyway.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。反正我们到了。

lines.en: : May I have the box?
lines.zh: : 能把盒子给我吗？

lines.en: scene black
I hand the box to Maya and take a moment to loosen up my shoulders as they've grown tight from carrying it for...what I'm pretty sure is several miles at this point.
lines.zh: 我把盒子递给 Maya，趁机松了松肩膀——扛了这么久（我很确定这会儿已经好几英里了），肩都僵了。

lines.en: Maya takes a quick look at the door in front of us, which is one I've never entered before, before sliding it open with her foot and disappearing inside.
lines.zh: Maya 快速看了一眼面前这扇我从没进过的门，然后用脚把它推开，消失在里面。

lines.en: : Please wait one moment.
lines.zh: : 请稍等。

lines.en: : And don't go anywhere.
lines.zh: : 别走开。

lines.en: : Why? Will you get scared if I leave you here on your own?
lines.zh: : 为什么？把你一个人留在这儿你会害怕吗？

lines.en: : Not as scared as you would be without me.
lines.zh: : 没有你，你会更害怕。

lines.en: : Oh? Is that another joke?
lines.zh: : 哦？那又是一个玩笑吗？

lines.en: : I wonder.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。

lines.en: scene secretsredux4
: Okay. I’m done.
lines.zh: : 好了。我办完了。

lines.en: : Done with what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体办完了什么？

lines.en: scene secretsredux3
: That doesn’t concern you.
lines.zh: : 那跟你没关系。

lines.en: : I'd say it does after spending my entire night helping you.
lines.zh: : 我花了一整晚帮你，就有关系。

lines.en: : Wow. One whole night. You're like a regular messiah or something, aren't you?
lines.zh: : 哇。整整一晚呢。你真像个救世主什么的，是吧？

lines.en: scene secretsredux4
: Listen...we should probably get going.
lines.zh: : 听着……我们大概该走了。

lines.en: : You may be allowed here after dark, but I could get into a lot of trouble if someone sees me.
lines.zh: : 天黑之后你待在这儿也许没事，可万一有人看见我，我就麻烦大了。

lines.en: : You realize I'm one of those people who could discipline you for this, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我就是那种有权因此处分你的人吧？

lines.en: : Oh, please. You’re barely even a teacher.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。你连老师都算不上。

lines.en: : You know...that's kind of fair. Carry on, Maya.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……这话有道理。继续吧，Maya。

lines.en: : Please stop saying my name. It makes my skin crawl.
lines.zh: : 请别再说我的名字了。听得我浑身发毛。

lines.en: scene black
scene secretsredux5
Things between us have been eerily quiet since we left the[school].
lines.zh: 自从离开[school]之后，我俩之间安静得反常。

lines.en: It's not like I expected them not to be considering that the distance between us feels like it's less distance and more of just some other plane of existence, but still.
lines.zh: 考虑到我俩之间的距离与其说像「距离」，不如说更像另一个位面，我本来也没指望不这样。可即便如此。

lines.en: I expected there to be more bickering.
lines.zh: 我本以为会有更多拌嘴。

lines.en: More insults.
lines.zh: 更多辱骂。

lines.en: More anything.
lines.zh: 更多任何东西。

lines.en: All we have right now is silence, though.
lines.zh: 可此刻我们拥有的只有沉默。

lines.en: Silence and the creeping acceptance that there's a side to this relationship that she'll probably never let me see.
lines.zh: 沉默，以及一点点爬进心里的认命——这段关系有一面，她大概永远不会让我看到。

lines.en: I get caught somewhere between the desire to keep looking away and another that would mean forcing everything she knows out of her.
lines.zh: 我被夹在两种欲望之间：一种想继续别过脸去，另一种想把她知道的一切全逼出来。

lines.en: How would I do that, you ask?
lines.zh: 你问我怎么逼？

lines.en: Ask me again when it isn't dark and I'll consider letting you know.
lines.zh: 等天不黑了再问我，我会考虑告诉你。

lines.en: : Hey.
Surprisingly enough, it’s Maya that breaks the silence before I do.
lines.zh: 出乎意料的是，先打破沉默的是 Maya。

lines.en: : Are you thirsty?
lines.zh: : 你渴吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...I guess a little bit. I did just carry some random box halfway across town.
lines.zh: : 呃……是有点。毕竟我刚扛着个莫名其妙的盒子走了半座城。

lines.en: : That wasn't anywhere close to halfway across town, but your exhaustion is understandable.
lines.zh: : 那连半座城的一半都算不上，不过你累了可以理解。

lines.en: : Do you have time for a minor detour?
lines.zh: : 你有时间绕个小路吗？

lines.en: : A detour? To where?
lines.zh: : 绕路？去哪儿？

lines.en: : Excellent. Please, follow me.
lines.zh: : 好极了。请跟我来。

lines.en: scene black
: That...was not an answer to my question.
lines.zh: : 那……并没有回答我的问题。

lines.en: : Perhaps it's best that you get used to me not answering your questions now if you're going to continue asking them.
lines.zh: : 如果你打算继续问下去，也许最好现在就习惯「我不回答你的问题」。

lines.en: Maya leads me into an alleyway illuminated by the moonlight and a pair of vending machines.
lines.zh: Maya 带我走进一条被月光和两台自动售货机照亮的小巷。

lines.en: She drops a few coins into one of them and, in what seems like a conditioned reflex, presses a button in the middle row.
lines.zh: 她往其中一台里丢了几枚硬币，然后像条件反射似的，按了中间那排的一个按钮。

lines.en: : Here.
scene vend1
: Thanks...
lines.zh: : 谢谢……

lines.en: : You’re welcome.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: I crack open the can and take a sip.
lines.zh: 我拉开拉环，喝了一口。

lines.en: It’s a sort of semi-sweetened iced coffee that causes a wave of nostalgia to sweep over me as I press my back against the cold alley wall.
lines.zh: 那是一种微甜的冰咖啡，当我的背靠上冰冷的小巷墙壁时，一股怀旧感席卷而来。

lines.en: Of course, things are once again awkward between the two of us and I feel a sudden urge to speak out.
lines.zh: 当然，我俩之间又变得尴尬起来，而我突然有种想开口的冲动。

lines.en: The weird thing with Maya is that I’m not even sure if I should try breaking the ice in times like these or not.
lines.zh: 跟 Maya 之间有个奇怪的地方：这种时候我甚至不确定该不该试着打破僵局。

lines.en: I feel like more than half the time she just tells me to stop talking.
lines.zh: 我感觉一半以上的时间里，她只会叫我别说话。

lines.en: : Well...this is new.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这倒是新鲜。

lines.en: : Is it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I mean, it's almost like the two of us are actually hanging out, right?
lines.zh: : 是啊。我是说，这几乎像我俩真的在一起玩了，对吧？

lines.en: : It’s much different than helping you carry things or visiting you at the shrine.
lines.zh: : 这比帮你搬东西、或者去神社看你，可不一样多了。

lines.en: : We’re not hanging out. I’m just repaying you for helping me.
lines.zh: : 我们不是在玩。我只是在报答你帮了我。

lines.en: : I know. But it still feels kind of new.
lines.zh: : 我知道。但还是感觉有点新鲜。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : This drink is really good, by the way. What is it?
lines.zh: : 对了，这饮料真不错。是什么？

lines.en: : I’m not sure.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定。

lines.en: : Well, thanks again either way. It...it kind of reminds me of something.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管怎样还是谢谢。它……有点让我想起什么东西。

lines.en: : I think.
lines.zh: : 我想。

lines.en: : I definitely recognize it from somewhere. I'm just...not really sure where.
lines.zh: : 我肯定在哪儿喝过。只是……不太确定在哪儿。

lines.en: : Is that so?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Well, probably. I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯。嗯，大概吧。我想。

lines.en: : I can't really say anything with certainty anymore.
lines.zh: : 我现在已经没法确定地说什么了。

lines.en: : This is the only vending machine in town that sells that. So chances are you've just been here before.
lines.zh: : 这是镇上唯一一台卖这个的自动售货机。所以你多半只是以前来过这儿。

lines.en: : Are you some sort of vending machine enthusiast or something?
lines.zh: : 你是某种自动售货机爱好者什么的吗？

lines.en: : Is that even a thing?
lines.zh: : 那也算是个东西？

lines.en: : Probably. There are enthusiasts for basically everything in this day and age.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。这年头基本什么都有爱好者。

lines.en: : Even teenage girls.
lines.zh: : 连青春期女孩都有。

lines.en: : There are probably a lot more of those than you would like to imagine.
lines.zh: : 那类爱好者大概比你愿意想象的要多得多。

lines.en: : I'm aware- as the amount I would like to imagine is zero and I'm currently standing next to at least one.
lines.zh: : 我知道——因为我愿意想象的数量是零，而我现在正站在至少一个旁边。

lines.en: : And you still bought a drink for him? Daring.
lines.zh: : 而你还给他买了杯饮料？真大胆。

lines.en: : Well...even someone like me can take risks every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 嗯……就算是我这样的人，偶尔也能冒个险。

lines.en: The conversation comes to a dead stop once again and the two of us are left in silence.
lines.zh: 对话再一次彻底停住，我俩陷入沉默。

lines.en: Every few minutes, a car will speed by and the sound of screeching tires will vibrate through the alley, bouncing off of the walls.
lines.zh: 每隔几分钟，会有一辆车飞驰而过，轮胎的尖啸在小巷里震动，在墙上弹来弹去。

lines.en: Those sounds, combined with the incessant humming of this pair of vending machines, creates what feels like an urban symphony.
lines.zh: 那些声音，加上这两台自动售货机没完没了的嗡嗡声，构成了一支像都市交响乐的东西。

lines.en: I want to fall asleep to it.
lines.zh: 我想听着它睡着。

lines.en: Unfortunately...I should probably be getting this girl home before it gets too late.
lines.zh: 可惜……我大概该在天太黑之前把这姑娘送回家。

lines.en: : Did you want to head out now?
lines.zh: : 你想现在回去吗？

lines.en: : Are you done drinking?
lines.zh: : 你喝完了吗？

lines.en: scene black
I take a few more sips from the can and kill it, tossing it into a nearby garbage bin.
lines.zh: 我又喝了几口，把罐喝光，扔进旁边的垃圾桶。

lines.en: : Yeah. I'm ready when you are.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你准备好我就好。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : Then, yes.
lines.zh: : 那么，是的。

lines.en: : I suppose we should be heading back now...
lines.zh: : 我想我们现在该回去了……

lines.en: Our return to the dorm doesn’t take too long, especially now that I'm not being held back by a surprisingly heavy cardboard box.
lines.zh: 回宿舍的路没花太久，尤其是现在没有那个出奇沉的纸箱拖我后腿了。

lines.en: When we finally reach the entrance, Maya does not say goodbye. She just nods at me and quickly walks back into the building as if she's already forgotten the lengths I went to for her tonight.
lines.zh: 等我们终于走到门口，Maya 没有道别。她只是对我点了点头，就快步走回楼里，好像已经忘了我今晚为她费了多大劲。

lines.en: I can't say I expected any less, though.
lines.zh: 不过我也没法说我期待更多。

lines.en: I know she doesn’t like being around me. Everyone knows she doesn't like being around me.
lines.zh: 我知道她不喜欢跟我待在一起。所有人都知道她不喜欢跟我待在一起。

lines.en: So tonight was probably just one more hassle for her...even if I was helping her out for the majority of it.
lines.zh: 所以今晚对她来说大概只是又一件麻烦事……就算大部分时间我是在帮她。

lines.en: Oh well.
lines.zh: 算了。

lines.en: There's no use thinking any more about it right now.
lines.zh: 现在想再多也没用。

lines.en: I'll just have to keep bothering her...
lines.zh: 我会继续烦她……

lines.en: Until there's nothing left for her to do but fall for me.
lines.zh: 直到她除了爱上我之外，别无选择。
